tasks.title: Preserve prototype and pin shell baseline
tasks.description: Verify archive branch/tag/bundle, fetch-only remotes, pinned upstream lock, and baseline evidence.
tasks.details: Validate archive refs and bundle SHA; verify v5.0.23 tests, release build, server/WebView startup, and record remaining manual playback checks.
tasks.testStrategy: Repository refs, bundle verification, cargo test/build, isolated process/network smoke.

tasks.title: Implement strict extension manifests and loader
tasks.description: Add safe mode, independent enablement, debug directories/CDP, origin-gated deterministic injection, and separate WebView2 profile.
tasks.details: Reject remote/absolute/traversal paths, duplicates, unsupported schemas, missing/oversized files; isolate extension failures.
tasks.testStrategy: Rust unit tests plus enabled/disabled startup smoke.

tasks.title: Implement shared resilient native storage
tasks.description: Create generic versioned JSON storage with validation, serialized access, atomic Windows replacement, backup, and corruption preservation.
tasks.details: Use fixed %LOCALAPPDATA%\JStremio\data paths, capped reads, same-directory UUID temps, flush/sync, known-good .bak.

tasks.title: Implement Reviews and Timestamp Notes native models
tasks.description: Add strict schemas, validation, timestamps/revisions, stable review keys, UUID note IDs, duration snapshots, and CRUD stores.
tasks.details: Reviews: rating 1-5 and 5000-char text. Notes: required text, ms bounds, multiple notes per timestamp, out-of-range support.
tasks.testStrategy: Rust boundary, CRUD, persistence, duplicate, and restart tests.

tasks.title: Implement origin-gated fixed IPC
tasks.description: Connect approved WebView origins to Reviews and Timestamp Notes operations with correlation, caps, and safe errors.
tasks.details: No arbitrary paths, commands, network, or generic MPV. Add fixed openDataFolder actions.

tasks.title: Build the TypeScript runtime and compatibility adapter
tasks.description: Add frozen idempotent window.JStremio, bridge, media targets, playback snapshots, restricted seek/pause, lifecycle, DOM adapter, overlay/dialog hosts, and diagnostics.
tasks.details: Parse MPV events without wrapping onCoreEvent; centralize upstream DOM heuristics and one reconciler.
tasks.testStrategy: Vitest runtime, media, message, validation, lifecycle, and fixture tests.

tasks.title: Implement Local Reviews extension
tasks.description: Add one navigation item, management overlay, current-player button, accessible editor, canonical navigation, CRUD refresh, and error states.
tasks.details: Shadow DOM UI; Reviews must never alter playback.

tasks.title: Implement Timestamp Notes capture and management
tasks.description: Add navigation/search/grouped overlay, capture-before-pause workflow, -5/+5/reset, conditional resume, editor, CRUD, and out-of-range warnings.
tasks.details: Disable for live, missing time/duration, external playback, or unstable video ID with an explanation.

tasks.title: Implement timeline markers and clustering
tasks.description: Mount a pointer-transparent marker layer on the current seek slider with resize/fullscreen/remount handling, tooltips, popovers, direct seek, edit/delete, and 10px clustering.
tasks.details: Absolute timestamps remain authoritative; hide out-of-range markers and never cross media targets.
tasks.testStrategy: Marker math, clustering, click seek, remount, keyboard, and normal seek tests.

tasks.title: Harden privacy and failure isolation
tasks.description: Exercise missing core/channel/time, live playback, DOM churn, bundle exceptions, IPC timeout, corrupt stores, and out-of-range timestamps.
tasks.details: Each failure disables only its feature; private text never enters logs or network.
tasks.testStrategy: Failure-injection, network inspection, and safe-mode tests.

tasks.title: Add checks, fixtures, and real-shell regression workflow
tasks.description: Provide check/run-dev/test-e2e scripts, deterministic legal media fixtures, WebView2/CDP opt-in checks, and enabled/disabled regression records.
tasks.details: Verify same official endpoint/server handoff/player path and unchanged volume/mute/audio/subtitle/stream behavior.
tasks.testStrategy: Cargo/TypeScript/Playwright/release build plus manual audible-output checklist.

tasks.title: Package and document JStremio
tasks.description: Produce separate portable JStremio output and optional unsigned installer metadata with separate identity/profile/data/updater behavior.
tasks.details: Document first login, backup/import, safe mode, rollback, update, SmartScreen, GPL, clean-profile validation, and hashes.
tasks.testStrategy: Portable clean-profile smoke, restart persistence, safe mode, and official-install coexistence checks.
